description: This file implements the WebAudioPlayerServerInternal class, which manages Web Audio playback using shared memory buffers, GStreamer, and threading. It includes methods for controlling playback, buffer management, and communication with a client interface.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerServerInternal
classes.description: Implements a server-side Web Audio player managing shared memory buffers, GStreamer pipeline, and threading for playback control and buffer management.

methods.name: initWebAudioPlayerInternal
methods.description: Initializes shared memory mapping, buffer pointers, and GStreamer WebAudio player setup.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Enqueues a task to start playback via the GStreamer player.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Enqueues a task to pause playback.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Enqueues a task to set end-of-stream, or marks EOS requested if there are queued frames.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer info and frames, ensuring thread-safe access.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Enqueues a task to write frames to shared memory and GStreamer pipeline.

methods.name: writeBufferInternal
methods.description: Handles the actual buffer writing logic, including wrapping and timer management.

methods.name: writeStoredBuffers
methods.description: Writes stored buffer data to GStreamer, handling wrap-around cases.

methods.name: updateAvailableBuffer
methods.description: Updates the available buffer info after data has been written to GStreamer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Provides preferred and maximum frame counts, supports deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Enqueues a task to set the playback volume.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Enqueues a task to retrieve the current volume.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Enqueues a task to notify the client of a state change.

methods.name: initGstWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates and configures the GStreamer WebAudio player instance.

methods.name: handleWriteDataTimer
methods.description: Handles periodic timer callbacks to write buffered data.

methods.name: getQueuedFramesInShm
methods.description: Calculates the number of queued frames in shared memory.
